title: 第8章 褒奖
content_zh:
第8章褒奖
张安世道：“可我没做错什……”
他的话音戛然而止。
却见一个宦官疾步进来，道：“宫中又有旨意。”
朱高炽一听，脸色骤变，刚刚训斥了一顿，难道现在又要被骂的狗血淋头？
连张氏也变得紧张起来，不禁担心地道：“莫非父皇……还是气不过，要追加罪责吗？”
朱高炽深吸一口气，无奈地看了张安世一眼，叹道：“孤去接旨，你们……在此……”
张氏蹙眉，道：“殿下，夫妻本是同林鸟，岂有大难临头各自飞的道理，我们同去。”
张安世看了姐夫姐姐一眼，也坚定地道：“我也去。”
太子与太子妃穿着吉服，出了内苑，至东宫前院詹事府的正堂前去接旨。
而此时，供职于东宫的詹事府上下官吏也早已在此迎奉圣旨了。
詹事府的官吏都是太子的属官，前头一封陛下不留情面的旨意，已让他们心惊胆颤，如今突然又来旨意，骤然让这些人嗅到了一丝诡谲的气氛。
当今皇帝不喜太子，人所共知，可是这样公开的训斥却是少有的事。
莫不是……有人进谗……陛下又生换储的心思了？
因此，当太子和太子妃抵达的时候，所有人心思复杂。
而当大家发现张安世也灰溜溜地跟在后头，不少人禁不住咬牙切齿。
罪魁祸首，不就是这个不争气的家伙吗？
太子若有闪失，大家的前程也都完了。
朱高炽心思也是复杂无比，他肥胖，腿脚又不利索，勉强支撑着拜下行礼：“儿臣接旨。”
前来传旨的宦官取了圣旨，朗声道：“奉天承运皇帝，敕曰……”

一听到这里，属官们虽一个个拜倒于地，鸦雀无声，只是许多人的心里却是狐疑起来。
是‘敕命’，这怎么回事？敕命是褒奖和加官晋爵才用的格式，难道不该是诫命吗？
朱高炽也一时懵了，只觉得云里雾里。
宦官道：“人非尧舜，谁能尽善？太子登储君位以来，克职尽忠，可谓矜矜业业……”
朱高炽虽然稳重，可此时却忍不住抬起了头，眼中满是错愕，以为自己听错了。
“孙子曰：善用兵者，无赫赫之功。今太子管教子弟，别出心裁，颇具匠心。今特旨敕告，是宜褒编，以彰潜德，钦哉！”
宦官念完了。
殿中却依旧还是鸦雀无声。
朱高炽此时是整个人都痴了。
他的父皇是马上得来天下的人，性情刚直，可是……
今日他也算是开了眼界，上午还下旨狠狠的申饬他一通，说他管教不了子弟，到了正午，却又褒奖他，说他是孙子一般无赫赫之功，却善用兵的人……这到底演的哪一出？
这时身后有人清咳，原来是属官们提醒太子接旨了。
朱高炽这才反应过来，于是忙是拜谢，接了旨。
他细细咀嚼，一时还是无法体会父皇的深意。
张安世这时却喜滋滋地道：“姐夫，这是陛下夸你呢，说你教我教的好。”
朱高炽脸都吓白了，连忙四顾左右，道：“父皇心思难测，你不要妄言。”
虽然制止了张安世，不过他大抵算是明白了，于是忙拉着张安世到后苑，询问张安世近来做了什么事。
张安世道：“我这几日，当真是在用心读书，上午的时候，学堂里还去了许多人，将那些平日顽劣的同窗打了个半死，唯独没有打我，宫里的人听了我叫张安世，还特意叫我走远一些，别溅的一身血。”
“陛下真了不起啊，他老人家明察秋毫，一眼便知我是个老实可靠的人。”
朱高炽：“……”

张氏也取了圣旨，端详了许久，喜道：“殿下，没错的，这就是夸赞咱们安世的圣旨，别看是夸殿下，其实就是拐弯抹角的说咱们安世有出息。”
朱高炽似乎依旧难以置信，道：“我不会是在做梦吧。”
张氏这时不乐意了：“我早说过，咱们安世是踏实本分的人，都是别人教唆，才偶尔出了一些岔子，可本心却是端方纯良的人。安世，你饿不饿，今日在此用膳……”
张安世摇摇头道：“不成，我还有事。”
“什么事。”这方才还兴师问罪的姐姐，转过头却又露出了溺爱的样子。
张安世道：“我兄弟屁股都打烂了，我得去给他寻医问药。”
张安世说着，便连忙告辞。
看着张安世一阵风般的跑了。
朱高炽拿过圣旨，又看了看，突然大笑：“一颗心总算落了地，咱们安世，倒也并非是一无是处。”
朱高炽的喜悦是可想而知的，毕竟方才还如履薄冰，如今却又得了圣旨的嘉许，一颗悬着的心总算是放下。
至于张安世，似乎近来真的是有所长进了，更值得欣慰。
…………
张安世是个有良心的人。
起初对张軏和朱勇，说实话……还是有一些利用的成分。
这其实也可以理解，这样的中二少年，你不去骗他，还是个人吗？
这两个家伙若放在后世，绝对是操着某省口音的电话诈骗份子们的目标用户啊。
可慢慢的相处，所谓的结拜兄弟，如今连他自己都信了。
现在张軏挨了打，也不知伤势怎么样，张世安不免心里记挂，无论如何，也要想办法去探望的。
上午的时候，张軏被打的皮开肉绽，需得带着一些伤药才好。
药是现成的，张安世来到这个世界，最怕的就是死，毕竟在这个时代，随时一个感冒发烧或者炎症就可能要人的命。

张安世在适应了这个世界之后的第一件事，就是尝试着给自己提炼一些以备不时之需的药。
譬如……青霉素。
其实青霉素早在唐朝的时候，就有长安城的裁缝会把浆糊涂在被剪刀划破的手指来帮助愈合伤口，而这种绿毛产生的物质其实就是青霉素素菌，有杀菌的作用。
当然，这种最原始的素菌其实效果强差人意。
想要增强效果，那么就需要将里头的素菌提取出来，而后用营养液，增加素菌的数量，并且提纯。
至于这培养基溶液，其实简单的很，只需用米磨成的汁水和山芋磨成的汁水混合一起，而后将素菌植入，等待十天半个月即可。
之后，再用漏斗以及瓦罐还有棉花、碳粉进行提纯，最终便可得出真正意义的青霉素。
张安世拿了一个小瓷瓶，将自己培养的青霉素小心翼翼地装好，随即便兴冲冲的出发，往张家去了。
…………
永乐皇帝在文楼里，则是满脸怒容。
他背着手，来回踱步，偶尔……发出骂娘的声音：“朕没想到这些家伙们会不成器到这样的地步，若朕是太祖高皇帝，非要将他们生生打死不可。“
又看过了一遍那些奏疏，发现除了那个张安世之外，其余之人……大多都是混账，这不禁让永乐皇帝担忧起来。
”尤其是那张軏，这小子最不是东西，他胆子大的很哪。“
骂过之后，一个宦官在外头道：“陛下……奴婢来复旨了。”
永乐皇帝阴沉着脸道：“进来说话。”
这宦官便蹑手蹑脚地进来，拜下道：“陛下……奴婢遵奉您的旨意，已经做出了处罚。尤其是恶首张軏，抽打了二十鞭子。”
“活该！”永乐皇帝朱棣气恼地道：“他爹若是在世，怕要将他打断腿。”
宦官伏地不敢接话。
永乐皇帝此时又道：“怎么样，这个小子知错了吗？”
“这……”

“这什么？”
“鞭挞之后……张軏已……已……”
朱棣脸色更加的凝重起来，皱着眉道：“什么意思？”
“已昏厥了过去……”
朱棣沉默了。
殿中出奇的安静。
宦官有些奇怪，小心翼翼地抬头瞄了朱棣一眼。
朱棣却突然声若洪钟道：“怎么，你们还真用刑了？”
宦官懵了，老半天说不出话来。
朱棣急眼了，怒骂道：“入你娘，他还只是一个娃娃啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 8 Testimonials
Zhang Anshi said: "But I didn't do anything wrong..."
His words stopped abruptly.
But I saw a eunuch walking in quickly and said: "There is another decree in the palace."
When Zhu Gaochi heard this, his expression suddenly changed. He had just been scolded, was he going to be scolded again?
Even Mrs. Zhang became nervous and couldn't help but worry: "Is it possible that the father... is still angry and wants to add more guilt?"
Zhu Gaochi took a deep breath, glanced at Zhang Anshi helplessly, and sighed: "I'm going to receive the order, you... are here..."
Zhang frowned and said, "Your Highness, husband and wife are birds of the same forest. How can they fly separately when disaster strikes? Let's go together."
Zhang Anshi glanced at his brother-in-law and sister, and said firmly: "I'll go too."
The prince and his wife, dressed in auspicious clothes, left the inner garden and went to the main hall of Zhan Shifu in the front yard of the East Palace to receive the order.
At this time, officials from the Zhan Shifu who worked in the East Palace were already here to welcome the imperial edict.
The officials of Zhan Shifu were all subordinates of the Crown Prince. The previous merciless decree from His Majesty had frightened them, and now there was another decree, which suddenly made these people smell a strange atmosphere.
It is well known that the current emperor does not like the prince, but such public reprimands are rare.
Could it be that... someone is slandering... Your Majesty is thinking of changing the reserve again?
Therefore, when the prince and princess arrived, everyone had mixed feelings.
And when everyone discovered that Zhang Anshi was following behind him in despair, many people couldn't help but grit their teeth.
Isn't the culprit this unlucky guy?
If the prince makes a mistake, everyone's future will be ruined.
Zhu Gaochi's thoughts were also extremely complex. He was fat and his legs and feet were not strong enough, so he could barely support himself and bowed down and said, "My son, I accept the order."
The eunuch who came to deliver the edict took the imperial edict and said loudly: "The emperor is entrusted with the destiny of heaven, and the edict says..."
Upon hearing this, although the subordinate officials fell to the ground one by one and remained silent, many people became suspicious in their hearts.
It’s an ‘edict’, what’s going on? Edicts are a form used only for commendations and promotions. Shouldn't they be commandments?
Zhu Gaochi was also confused for a moment, feeling confused and confused.
The eunuch said: "Who can do good things other than Yao and Shun? Since the prince ascended the throne, he has devoted himself to his duties and is very dedicated to his career..."
Although Zhu Gaochi was steady, he couldn't help but raise his head at this time. His eyes were full of astonishment, thinking that he had heard wrongly.
"Sun Tzu said: Those who are good at using soldiers have no great merits. Now the prince disciplines his children with unique ideas and ingenuity. This is a special edict. It is appropriate to praise and compile it to highlight the latent virtues. Thank you!"
The eunuch finished reading.
There was still silence in the palace.
Zhu Gaochi was completely crazy at this time.
His father was a man who would conquer the world immediately and had an upright temperament, but...
Today was an eye-opener for him. In the morning, he issued an edict and warned him harshly, saying that he could not discipline his children. At noon, he praised him again, saying that he was like a grandson who had no outstanding achievements but was good at using soldiers... What kind of performance was this?
At this time, someone coughed behind him. It turned out that it was the officials who reminded the prince to accept the order.
Only then did Zhu Gaochi realize what he was doing, so he quickly thanked him and accepted the order.
He chewed it carefully, but for the moment he still couldn't understand the profound meaning of his father.
At this time, Zhang Anshi said happily: "Brother-in-law, His Majesty is complimenting you, saying that you taught me well."
Zhu Gaochi's face turned pale with fright. He quickly looked around and said, "My father's thoughts are unpredictable. Don't make false statements."
Although he stopped Zhang Anshi, he probably understood it, so he hurriedly took Zhang Anshi to the back garden and asked Zhang Anshi what he had done recently.
Zhang Anshi said: "I have really been studying hard these days. In the morning, many people came to the school and beat the usually naughty classmates half to death, but they didn't beat me. When the people in the palace heard that my name was Zhang Anshi, they specially told me to go away and stop splashing.Covered in blood. "
"Your Majesty is so amazing. He is so perceptive and can tell at a glance that I am an honest and reliable person. "
Zhu Gaochi: "..."
Zhang also took the imperial edict, looked at it for a long time, and said happily: "Your Highness, that's right, this is an imperial edict to praise our An Shi. Although it may seem like a compliment to Your Highness, it is actually just a roundabout way of saying that our An Shi is promising. "
Zhu Gaochi still seemed to be in disbelief and said: "I can't be dreaming. "
Mrs. Zhang was not happy at this time: "I have said before that our Anshi is a down-to-earth person. We only occasionally make some mistakes because of the instigation of others, but we are honest and upright people at heart. An Shi, are you hungry? Let's have a meal here today..."
Zhang Anshi shook his head and said: "No, I still have something to do. "
"What's up. "The sister who had just started to accuse her turned her head and showed a doting look.
Zhang Anshi said: "My brother's butt is smashed, I have to go find a doctor for him. "
Zhang Anshi said and left quickly.
Watching Zhang Anshi run away like a gust of wind.
Zhu Gaochi took the imperial edict, looked at it again, and suddenly laughed: "My heart finally fell to the ground, our Anshi is not useless. "
Zhu Gaochi's joy can be imagined. After all, he was walking on thin ice just now, but now he has been praised by the imperial edict, and his hanging heart is finally relieved.
As for Zhang Anshi, it seems that he has really improved recently, which is even more gratifying.
…………
Zhang Anshi is a conscientious person.
At first, to be honest, Zhang Fu and Zhu Yong were somewhat exploited.
This is actually understandable. If you don’t lie to such a middle-aged boy, are you still a human being?
In future generations, these two guys would definitely be the target users of phone scammers who speak with accents from a certain province.
But as they got along slowly, he now believed in the so-called sworn brothers.
Now that Zhang Fu had been beaten and the condition of his injury was unknown, Zhang Shian couldn't help but worry about it. No matter what, he had to find a way to visit him.
In the morning, Zhang Fu was beaten until his skin and flesh were torn apart, so he needed to bring some medicine for his injuries.
Medicines are readily available. When Zhang Anshi came to this world, what he feared most was death. After all, in this era, a cold, fever or inflammation could kill someone at any time.
The first thing Zhang Anshi did after adapting to this world was to try to refine some medicine for himself in case of emergency.
For example...penicillin.
In fact, as early as the Tang Dynasty, tailors in Chang'an City would apply penicillin paste to fingers cut by scissors to help heal the wounds. The substance produced by this green hair is actually penicillin bacteria, which has a bactericidal effect.
Of course, the effect of this most primitive fungus is actually unsatisfactory.
If you want to enhance the effect, you need to extract the bacteria inside, then use nutrient solution to increase the number of bacteria and purify it.
As for the culture medium solution, it is actually very simple. You only need to mix the juice made from ground rice and the juice made from ground potato, then implant the bacteria and wait for ten days and a half.
After that, it is purified using funnels, earthen jars, cotton, and carbon powder, and finally the true penicillin can be obtained.
Zhang Anshi took a small porcelain bottle, carefully packed the penicillin he had cultivated, and then set off happily to Zhang's house.
…………
Emperor Yongle was in the literary building with an angry look on his face.
He paced back and forth with his hands behind his back, and occasionally... made a scolding sound: "I didn't expect these guys to be so useless. If I were Emperor Taizu Gao, I would beat them to death. "
After reading the memorials again, I found that except for Zhang Anshi, most of the others... were bastards, which made Emperor Yongle worried.
"Especially that Zhang Fu, this kid is the worst, he is very courageous. "
After scolding, a eunuch cameOutside said: "Your Majesty... this servant has come to answer the order."
Emperor Yongle said gloomily: "Come in and talk."
The eunuch then crept in, bowed down and said: "Your Majesty... I have obeyed your will and have already punished you. Especially the evil one, I have been punished with twenty lashes."
"You deserve it!" Yongle Emperor Zhu Di said angrily: "If his father were still alive, I'm afraid he would have his legs broken."
The eunuch fell to the ground and did not dare to answer.
Emperor Yongle asked again at this time: "How about it, does this boy realize his mistake?"
"This..."
"What is this?"
"After the whipping...Zhang Fu has...already..."
Zhu Di's face became more solemn, and he frowned and said, "What do you mean?"
"Has fainted..."
Zhu Di was silent.
The palace was surprisingly quiet.
The eunuch was a little strange and cautiously raised his head and glanced at Zhu Di.
Zhu Di suddenly said in a loud voice: "What, you really tortured me?"
The eunuch was stunned and speechless for a long time.
Zhu Di became anxious and cursed angrily: "Fuck your mother, he is just a doll!"
